title: Provincial Motor Vehicles North-West Frontier Province Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Motor Vehicles North-West Frontier Province Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2010
ACT VI OF 2010
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the
Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
20th March, 2010]
No.
PA/N.-W.F.P./Bills/2010/10568, dated 20-3-2010.---The
Provincial Motor Vehicles (North-West Frontier Province) (Amendment) Bill, 2010
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province
on 11th March, 2010 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on 16th March, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
(W.P. Ordinance No. XIX of 1965), for
the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Provincial Motor Vehicles (North-West Frontier Province)
(Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.
